notes.title: New locations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/f4dbb6c3e77120dfe5fe984d456cd472f0d6f13c.jpg[/img]
Hi friends, the release of Lost Scavenger is just around the corner, we are actively working on bugs, making changes that the players proposed, as well as developing new mechanics and content. And as one of the interesting novelties in the game, there is an opportunity to travel between new procedurally generated locations that you can find (or not). These new areas are a real challenge to the mature survivalist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/3851e5984901aedeaf04caa4d07f7741a8f6db39.jpg[/img]
They came under the influence of the Mist much earlier and the degree of decomposition is stronger here. The differences are not only in the landscape, and not the most favorable (deserts, swamps), and new objects such as raider bases and industrial buildings, but also in the number of likely opponents such as mutants and their strength. In general, explore and discover new places, if, of course, you have courage for this...

notes.title: A little about the plot
notes.content:
A few words about the Lost Scavenger plot. Events unfold in a dying world. It almost does not differ from ours, except for one fact - 30 years ago this world was captured by something called Mist. It looks like an ordinary fog, but after entering it, they don't come back: some go crazy, others turn into mutants, and rumors about the fate of others are even worse...

The player enters this world for reasons inexplicable to him. To find the answers you want, you first need to survive. The player's attitude to the Mist and the path along which he will go will determine the further development of the story. Will he try to return home, will he decide to fight the Mist, or will he try to understand it and reveal its secrets?

This world is a strange place to which the player does not belong. To survive, you will have to get used to the necessity to go against your conscience. A choice will constantly arise: is your own temporary well-being more important than humanity and the pangs of conscience? One way or another, it will hurt either your body or your state of mind. Whatever decision the character makes, considering it right or necessary at this moment, sooner or later the consequences will make themselves felt. In order not to tell too much the details of the plot and possible events, I will only say that Lost Scavenger is an adult game, it does not avoid topics of sex, drugs and cruelty. So death is not the worst thing that can happen to a character.

notes.title: DevDiary. Body temperature
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/3b96490cfb65f0ea8ef4c5cbe92052f716ccd8e2.jpg[/img]

Hello! Today I’d like to talk about the mechanics of body temperature in Lost Scavenger.

The environment temperature and equipment affect the character's body temperature and the game will not have any surprises in this regard: the colder it is outside, the warmer the player needs to dress :). 

Each item has a thermal insulation parameter - it indicates how well the item maintains body temperature and the slot (head / body / legs) that it insulates.

Thermal insulation determines how much heat is retained by this thing. You can combine several items to insulate one slot, but not more than 100%. For example, wearing a T-shirt with 10% thermal insulation and a sweater with 60%, the body will receive 70% thermal insulation.

Body heat loss is distributed across all slots, and is calculated as follows: body - 50%, head - 20%, legs -30%. Thus, the bare torso affects heat loss the most and needs to be insulated first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/0f799a6fbc44feb26eb57d9f6fc17b3eec7c8aca.jpg[/img]

The character's body temperature changes over time. As in real life, stripping naked, a person does not freeze instantly - the process of hypothermia occurs gradually. So in Lost Scavenger, the change occurs over time, the value of the change depends on the Final Dynamics, the calculation of this dynamics can be seen below (now there will be a little math):

[b]The final calculation of the dynamics of change is as follows:[/b]

[b]Total thermal insulation[/b] = (coefficient of all things of the body / 100) * 0.5 + (coefficient of all things of the head / 100) * 0.2 + (coefficient of all things of the legs / 100) * 0.3 + coefficients of effects. For example, (30/100) * 0.5 + (70/100) * 0.2 + (70/100) * 0.3 = 0.5

[b]Influence of temperature[/b] = current temperature - minimum temperature / maximum temperature - minimum temperature, for example now 15 degrees (15-10) / (25-10) = 0.6

[b]Final dynamics[/b] = -Maximum Value of Dynamics + (MWD * Influence of temperature + MWD * General thermal insulation) In our case, MWD = 3%, as a result, we get -3+ (3 * 0.6 + 3 * 0.5) = 0.3%.

Thus, even with maximum thermal insulation, the player will have to periodically warm up by the fire, and when walking without clothes in bad weather, the player will quickly get hypothermia (I will tell you about the change in weather and, accordingly, temperature another time, this part of the game requires a separate release).

In the event of a decrease in temperature, the player receives negative effects - at 50% freezing, at 20% hypothermia - which can impose additional diseases: colds, pneumonia, etc. If a player gets wet in the rain or when crossing a river without a raft, bonuses from thermal insulation of clothing are completely lost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/8dec28bbf2ec4518b3fbf0771fc7fe0d9571f2de.jpg[/img]

Hot food and drink will raise your body temperature. If the character is resting by the fire or in the settlement, then the body temperature is restored the fastest. I will tell you about the rest in the next diary. See you soon!

notes.title: Character’s parameters. Part 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/8d59d4e3200b4483f1faf80bf9b06c536e5ee829.jpg[/img]

Hello again! Last time I [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1571160/announcements/detail/2978552879956494605]talked [/url]about the parameters of the character in Lost Scavenger and settled on the health of our unfortunate hero, who is forced to starve, freeze, get sick and suffer in every possible way in the vastness of an unfamiliar and ruined world.

Now let's move on to hunger, thirst, and fatigue. Hunger and thirst constantly decrease over time, dropping these parameters below 25% leads to dehydration and exhaustion. These effects have an extremely negative aftermath on the character's health parameter. As in real life, the character dies within a week without food or water.

Nutritious food, in addition to quickly restoring the hunger scale, can add a positive effect that temporarily slows down the rate at which this parameter falls. In turn, poorly cooked, missing or simply unpleasant food for the character imposes negative effects.

The character can quench his thirst in any puddle, but the use of non-disinfected water increases the intoxication. When you hover over the status bar of interest, the factors influencing its rise or fall will be displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/3831ef0bcf688a24db43e92e78222c7751f440b9.png[/img]

There are several ways to get safe water for drinking and boiling over a fire is the easiest of them. You can also find special water disinfectants, find sealed bottles of clean water, or order lunch at the settlement.

Stress. Its level is also one of the main parameters of the body. It characterizes the psychological state of the player. When he experiences the negative effects associated with trauma, meeting the needs of the body and external influences of the environment, stress begins to accumulate. Dangerous situations and unexpected encounters can also negatively affect this parameter. When the stress level reaches its critical values, the player begins to experience the effects of psychological disorders, which negatively affect the speed of energy replenishment, the speed of actions, etc. Having received a nervous breakdown, the player can break loose in dialogues with other people, which will not in the best way dispose him to the interlocutor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/2e6c6726dd5bbfbc09aa13010b051d0df8e39c2b.png[/img]

To replenish this parameter, you need to minimize the negative effects affecting the character. A good way is to relax in the taverns of the settlements or to take soft drugs.

That's all for today! Keep abreast of your parameters, each of them is very important and neglecting them would be a big mistake...

notes.title: Character’s parameters. Part 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we'll talk about the parameters of the characters and how they change and what they affect. Each character in Lost Scavenger has a set of BASIC parameters that reflect his condition. Each parameter is measured on a scale from 0 to 100%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/25fe578cb17d96ecedc7f10d004499959b9fbe73.png[/img]

Also, the parameters have an indicator of DYNAMICS of change, it is by the value of this indicator that the base value changes with the passage of time. Also, the dynamics have a target value to which it aims. Sounds confusing? Now let's try to figure out how it works.

As in real life, most of the changes in the body occur over time. So, the level of how hungry you are is determined by the base value (for example, 50% means that you are very hungry). And according your metabolism and activity, the rate at which you get hungrier is dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/33da7334ba9b41d52c80071c42ae46b0f488ba20.png[/img]

So, the first parameter to be considered is Health. This parameter reflects how healthy your hero's body is in physical terms. The basic dynamics of this parameter is positive and, if the body is not affected by negative effects, then health is slowly but surely restored. In Lost Scavenger you cannot drink a potion that instantly restores health. It simply does not exist, but you can visit a doctor in the settlements, make a camp and maximize the value of all parameters. A well-rested person with a full stomach and without illness recovers his health the fastest. There are rumors that there are medicines obtained from the creatures of the Mist, which significantly accelerate regeneration, but also accelerate the mutation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/9c6dff76cf562d30a61ca33919db7dfe0ddb79d0.png[/img]

The negative factors affecting health are just unlimited amount: diseases and injuries, depending on their degree of recovery, affect most of all; negative effects from increased radiation and intoxication have a small but permanent effect; unqualified treatment can cause great damage to health. Do not forget about the hostile environment, in battle you can also lose a lot of valuable health.

n the next part I will talk about other parameters. Stay tuned and thank you for your attention!

notes.title: Carrying things and spoiling food
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/0cdf215bbaad9c082ae945c4f4042e8acfbe20ad.gif[/img]

Inventory mechanics and micro-management of items and resources are very important aspects of the game. Each item has two main characteristics - size and weight. The game has a large number of containers for carrying items. They, in turn, are subdivided into specialized and common.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/8e0290213a0773dc8fc81a78420b7460eb256d19.png[/img]

Specialized containers can only hold items of a certain category. For example, a bandolier has a large number of slots, but only cartridges can be placed in it. Also there are first-aid kits which can only store medicines, and quivers for arrows.

Special mention should be made of such containers as scrapers and carts. They allow you to carry a truly huge amount of items and resources, but this will require the use of both hands, which, in turn, entails fewer available opportunities in battle and slows down movement on the global map. By the way, it will not be possible to cross the river without using a raft with such containers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/9e577304fe081d9c902061f91daaeb0f5e1daa7a.png[/img]

Any bag or scraper wears out over time, and when it happens, a hole may form in the container. This slot will become unavailable, and at the moment the hole appears the item that was in this slot will drop out.
The decay mechanic is found in most survival games, and Lost Scavenger is no exception. Each product has a status bar that decreases over time. If it drops to zero, the food is considered to be spoiled.
 
Information about this can be obtained in the product properties. The spoiled products can be eaten, but at the same time, the character's scale of intoxication rises, plus other negative effects are possible: diarrhea, vomiting and other diseases.

So keep a close eye on your gear and what you eat!

Well, in conclusion - a small inventory diagram with explanations:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/e690f04b7efb186471c4db3b77c51addfa44d43a.jpg[/img]

1. Item's condition - reflects the quality and degree of wear.
2. Spoiled food - you can still eat it, but at your own peril and risk...
3. The number of items in the stack.
4. The available amount of ammunition for this weapon.
5. The current number of items in the container.
6. Holes in the container - they block slots. If a hole appears on a slot occupied by an object, it falls to the ground.

notes.title: Crafting mechanics. Part 2
notes.content:
I am worried that in [b]Lost Scavenger[/b], in my basic system learning the blueprint (opening the exact positions of materials), described in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1571160?emclan=103582791470228456&emgid=2977424442354087368]previous [/url] issues, there will be no place for deliberate experiment, but only a quick drain of components in failed attempts in exchange for opening positions. In this regard, the idea was born to make this process in the spirit Battleship (game).

Let's consider the process step by step using the example of such a random blueprint.

[b]First attempt:[/b]
We received a new blueprint, we know the necessary materials, but we do not know the positions, so we spread them randomly and click "[b]Create[/b]":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/5b2732649ff7cb399fa5817415ca8e73a2563080.png[/img]

[b]Failure:[/b]
• All materials destroyed
• All cells under the materials are marked as "hit" / "missed"
• Material Bandage occupies only one square and was fully discovered (1), so now we see it as a slot for a material (according to the rules of current slots)
• A random cell of the material is discovered (2)
Now our drawing looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/d13395286e86d1eb55b61381c49ef21f9395ef77.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/f2f97b368ec3f838d116e5f25a1e4cf5b9a2371e.png[/img]

[b]Second attempt:[/b]
Seeing the open tips, we try to guess the location of the materials again. The bandage is discovered, so we cannot place it in any other place other than its slot (according to the rules of the current slots).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/025cfac5bf0bb7bed29521479690ee8bff80f885.png[/img]

[b]Failure:[/b]
• The axe and knife are destroyed, the bandage remains because it was in the correct position.
• All cells under the materials are marked as "hit" / "missed"
• A random cell of the material is discovered (1)

Now our blueprint looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/5b2c50a001aa418947608d4f2cf6490fe72afdba.png[/img]

[b]3rd attempt:[/b]
Looking at the hints, we understand the position of the axe, trying to discover the knife, but...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/d1b91f663cebfb710edcb7d7db5b21ab856b3297.png[/img]

...failure again:
• The knife is destroyed, the bandage and axe remain because they were in the correct positions.
• The axe slot is discovered.
• All cells under the materials are marked as "hit" / "missed"
• Open one random cell of the material (1). Since only one cell of the material (1) is hidden, open the knife slot

The blueprint is discovered:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/433ab6f3ce0ec338c6f60be34b1581a2e7875cf0.png[/img]

[b]Summary:[/b]

We get an interesting minigame as a craft, where the speed of discovering the blueprint depends on luck and intelligence, moreover, you do not sacrifice ready-made functionality, but only supplement it. Without such a mechanic, no one will try to guess the exact position of the material, but simply burn the materials until all slots are open, i.e. the position of the slots on the table will be empty mechanics.
Accidentally unlocked slots on a failure serve as compensation and help guide the player to avoid burning too many resources in the beginning, especially in recipes with single-celled materials.
Parsing an item opens a blueprint, subsequent parsing opens 1 random cell of the material.

So this is the second variant of craft mechanic in Lost Scavenger. What do you think, is it worth it? Thank you!

notes.title: Crafting mechanic. Pt.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I would like to talk about a mechanic of crafting in Lost Scavenger. Main emphasis of the game is on surviving in a hostile environment, simulating the needs of the body (food, medicine, temperature, etc.) and finding and crafting items you need for this uneasy case. It is about the latter that I would like to tell, or rather, about a part of it.

So, the game focuses on crafting items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/66b736185409d30c0e960c82939e4c587852226b.jpg[/img]

During the game our character will constantly have to make or cook something to survive. Most of the categories of items can be made from both primitive improvised materials and from higher quality materials collected from the remains of civilization. To fix the fracture, you put on a medical splint, or you just can make an impromptu one from branches and ropes.

To make an item of proper quality, you will need:

Discover the blueprint - this will give information about the components, tools and requirements for its manufacture. This can be done in the following ways:

- to read in a newspaper or book, which sometimes come across when searching urban areas.

- ask the NPC for money or during the quest.

- sometimes blueprint can be recognized when disassembling the item.

- experiment! Nothing prevents you from taking a stick, knife, rope and attempting to create a primitive spear. It is not a fact that you will succeed, and some of the components will be destroyed if your attempt fails, but Fortune favors the brave! =)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/983f36206bbbfda247637c9fa48e78fd8d3f014d.jpg[/img]

2. Learn how to do it

The process studying is expressed in the discovery of the exact positions of each component on the crafting table - each item which is out of its position will significantly reduce the final quality (strength) of the item received. If the durability is below zero, the item will not be crafted. The process of opening these positions is a lot like opening the blueprint itself. We can:

- continue to disassemble items.

- try to create an item by placing components on the table at random - in case of failure, some of the components will be destroyed, but the position of one of them will be open. It will also discover the position of the component you guessed it at.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/d9e78c6fe809b9c5b31ca812ada00db5f5bbc096.jpg[/img]

The chance of opening a position depends on item’s tire - the more complicated the item, the longer it takes to learn to do it. Some perks and character’s background speed up this process, increasing the chance of opening a position of materials or opening 2 positions at a time - I want smart characters to have the same chances of surviving as strong ones. =)

3. When the most difficult thing is over, it remains only to find materials and tools of suitable quality! It is also worth to keep in mind that complex recipes may require a character’s specialized perks or workshop, which can only be used in some settlements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/dd7e3f45aea4095b1b357e64b953ad32e780d80e.jpg[/img]

Basic blueprints and recipes like bonfire, boiling water, club, etc. will be available at the beginning of the game, the rest will have to be made in the process. The quality of the crafted item depends on the quality of the raw materials and the tools used, which, by the way, wear out in the process.

My main task is to make the craft process, on the one hand, not casual, but on the other, not too routine, because you will have to resort to it often. I will tell you more about the existing crafting model, interface, as well as an alternative idea in the next issues.

I would be grateful if you share your opinion, is this crafting process too confused, can it arouse your interest in mastering new blueprints, or, conversely, scare you away from the game? Thank you!

notes.title: Stimulants in the game. Use it wisely or not use it at all
notes.content:
Hey! [b]Lost Scavenger[/b] has a large number of different interesting mechanics related to the simulation of real processes in the human body. We will tell about all of them in as much detail as possible and start, perhaps, with the most ambiguous in terms of benefits - various stimulants and drugs. You may ask, why introduce the mechanics, which may not be useful in the game? The fact is that the game is quite hardcore and one wrong step or answer in dialogues can easily lead to the character's death. Therefore, we have introduced the mechanics of stimulants, which slightly increase certain characteristics and abilities, which can become exactly the straw that will tip the scales in your favor. However, everything has its own price.

In the game you will find several types of "stimulating" remedies. They increase the dynamics of all the main parameters of the character (i.e., having taken the drug, the player's stress level begins to decrease, the reserve of strength and the speed of all actions increase) for a short time. Some remedies allow you to ignore wounds and diseases for a certain time.

The downside of taking stimulants is drug withdrawal. It occurs with some degree of probability after the end of the drug. The likelihood of withdrawal depends on the severity of the stimulant and the frequency of its use (the less often you use it, the less chance of withdrawal you'll have). Withdrawal symptoms have a negative impact on the basic parameters and may be accompanied by diarrhea and vomiting. You can get rid of symptoms over time (time depends on the severity of the effect and takes from 3 to 10 days) or by taking a new dose of stimulants.

The main source of these synthetic stimulants are abandoned military bases and bunkers. Merchants in settlements also can offer you to buy some stuff. Stimulants can be produced independently from herbal ingredients, but you need to have the appropriate knowledge.
Producing items and medicines will be in the next part. So stay on :)
